name: Shereen Sarsour
credentials: Pursuing a Master's in Educational Leadership · Bachelor's in Organizational Development and Administration · Certified in English Education
bio: Pursuing master's degree in Educational Leadership, currently holds a Bachelor's degree in Organizational Development and Administration, along with certification in English education. As Head of School, she supports teachers, guides academic programs, and fosters a welcoming school community rooted in Islamic values. An educator and mother of five, she values strong family partnerships and is committed to nurturing each student's academic, personal, and spiritual growth.
summary: Pursuing a master's in Educational Leadership; supports teachers and guides academic programs.

name: Iffath Afroz
credentials: Bachelor's in Unani Medicine and Surgery, Nizamia Tibbi College · Pursuing an Ijazah in Qur'an, American Qur'an Academy
bio: Iffath Afroz holds a Bachelor's degree in Unani Medicine and Surgery from Nizamia Tibbi College and is currently pursuing an Ijazah in Qur'an from the American Qur'an Academy in Toledo, Ohio. As Administrative Coordinator, she supports school operations and serves as a welcoming first point of contact for families navigating enrollment. She is deeply committed to ICCR Academy and its students, working closely with staff and families to foster a supportive school community and help build a bright future for every child. Outside of school, she enjoys spending quality time with her family, swimming, and reading.
summary: The first point of contact for families; pursuing an Ijazah in Qur'an.

name: Dr. Tariq Igram
role: Islamic Studies Director · Advanced Islamic Studies
bio: Dr. Tariq Igram teaches Advanced Islamic Studies, directs ICCR Academy's Islamic Studies program, and serves as School Board Chairman. Born in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, he holds degrees in Business Administration and Shariah (Islamic Law) from the University of Iowa and the Islamic University of Madinah in Saudi Arabia. Fluent in English and Arabic, he is also Director of Shariah and Marketing for Islamic Services of America, specializing in Islamic legal research, halal education, and industry guidance. He enjoys family time, hunting, and fishing.
summary: Shariah degree from the Islamic University of Madinah; directs ICCRA's Islamic Studies program.

name: Sr. Rehab Salam
bio: Sr. Rehab Salam brings eight years of experience teaching non-native Arabic speakers. She holds an Ijazah in Al-Qa'idah An-Noraniyyah and is pursuing an Ijazah in the Holy Qur'an. Her patient, encouraging approach helps students enjoy learning Arabic and the Qur'an while building confidence in reading, pronunciation, and understanding. A mother of five living in Cedar Rapids, Sr. Rehab values patience, consistency, and individualized support. Outside teaching, she enjoys traveling, walking, and cycling.
summary: Eight years teaching Arabic to non-native speakers; holds an Ijazah in Al-Qa'idah An-Noraniyyah.

name: Sr. Rafah Alsabea
bio: Sr. Rafah Alsabea serves as the Tarbiyah teacher and counselor at ICCR Academy. She holds master's degrees in Marriage and Family Therapy and Islamic Studies, along with a bachelor's degree in Childhood Psychology. With over 20 years of teaching experience in Syria and the United States, she is dedicated to nurturing students' faith, character, and emotional well-being through Islamic values and compassionate guidance.
summary: Master's degrees in Marriage and Family Therapy and Islamic Studies; 20+ years of teaching.

name: Ms. Tessa Horn
bio: Tessa Horn brings nine years of experience as an elementary English Language Learner (ELL) teacher and holds a master's degree in K–6 Literacy and a certificate in Educational Coaching. At ICCR Academy, she supports teachers in classroom management and instructional strategies and leads professional development to strengthen teaching and learning. Outside of school, she enjoys painting, writing poetry, and traveling.
summary: Master's in K–6 Literacy; nine years as an elementary English Language Learner teacher.

name: Ms. Hannah Horn
bio: Hannah Horn holds a bachelor's degree in Social Studies Teaching from the University of Northern Iowa and is pursuing a master's degree in Middle School Education with endorsements in Science and Language Arts at Morningside University. Her experience includes teaching internships in Cedar Rapids and at Amadeus International School in Vienna, Austria, along with serving as a building substitute at Prairie Point Middle School. Outside the classroom, she enjoys traveling, reading, spending time with family, and crafting.
summary: Social Studies Teaching degree from UNI; pursuing a master's in Middle School Education.

name: Ms. Asma Anwar Basha
role: Math Instructor, Grades 6–8 · Math Tutor, Grades 9–12
bio: Ms. Asma Anwar Basha holds a Master of Technology in VLSI and Embedded Systems and a bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering. She brings three years of teaching mathematics at ICCR Academy and five years of experience as a lecturer at engineering colleges in India. She is passionate about building students' confidence, strengthening their math skills, and helping them reach their full potential. Outside the classroom, she enjoys spending time with family and friends, drinking chai, and watching travel vlogs.
summary: M.Tech in VLSI and Embedded Systems; five years as an engineering lecturer in India.

name: Sr. Asma Ashad
bio: Asma Ashad brings ten years of teaching experience across diverse educational settings. She holds a bachelor's degree in Economics and Development Studies and a Diploma in Primary School Teaching. She is currently pursuing a post-baccalaureate Bachelor of Science in Elementary Education at Mount Mercy University and holds an Iowa Professional Educator License with an endorsement in grades 5–12 Economics and Social Studies.
summary: Ten years of teaching; Iowa Professional Educator License in 5–12 Economics and Social Studies.

name: Ms. Sarah Anwar
bio: Sarah Anwar holds a master's degree in Law and bachelor's degrees in Law and Business Administration. She brings strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills to her teaching, helping students develop confidence, independence, and critical thinking. She is dedicated to creating a supportive, engaging classroom where every child feels valued and encouraged to succeed. Sarah values collaboration, celebrates both small and large accomplishments, and nurtures a lifelong love of learning. A mother of two, she enjoys puzzles, Sudoku, baking, kayaking, hiking, and traveling.
summary: Master's in Law; helps students build confidence, independence, and critical thinking.

name: Sr. Zahra Khan
bio: Sr. Zahra Khan has over 20 years of teaching experience, including ten years in Iowa. She holds certifications in Neuropsychology and NAMC Early Childhood Montessori, along with Iowa substitute teaching authorization.
summary: 20+ years of teaching, ten in Iowa; certified in Neuropsychology and Montessori education.

name: Br. Salah Jung
bio: Salah Jung is a recent graduate of Iowa State University with a degree in Kinesiology and Health on the pre-dental track. During his time at Iowa State, he was actively involved in the Muslim Student Association, serving in leadership roles for three years, and spent four years conducting research in the Alternative Medicine for Parkinson's Disease Laboratory. He has also spent the past ten years studying Islamic subjects, including fiqh, aqeedah, and tarbiyah, under Shaykh Dr. Tariq Igram. In his free time, he enjoys playing soccer, spending time with friends, and reading nonfiction books.
summary: Iowa State graduate in Kinesiology and Health; four years of Parkinson's disease research.

name: Ms. Fatima Hamad
bio:
Fatima Hamad holds a master's degree in English Literature from Pakistan and an associate degree from Kirkwood Community College. She is currently pursuing a bachelor's degree at the College of Education, majoring in Art and minoring in Education. Fatima also holds a K–12 substitute teaching license.

Fatima has one year of experience working at Hand in Hand Daycare, two years of substitute teaching experience, and has also taught at ICCR Academy. She is passionate about creating a welcoming and inspiring classroom where students can explore their creativity and develop their artistic skills.

In her free time, Fatima enjoys organizing her home, painting, designing jewelry, and playing with her cat. Her favorite color is green, and her favorite season is fall.
summary: Master's in English Literature; studying Art and Education, with a K–12 substitute license.

name: Dr. Tariq Igram
bio: Holds degrees in Business Administration from the University of Iowa and Shariah (Islamic Law) from the Islamic University of Madinah. Director of Shariah and Marketing for Islamic Services of America, specializing in Islamic legal research, halal education, and industry guidance.

name: Rafah Alsabea
bio: Community member, counselor, and teacher. Holds master's degrees in Marriage and Family Therapy and Islamic Studies, and a bachelor's degree in Childhood Psychology.

name: Dr. Omar Igram
bio: Community member and orthopedic surgeon, active in medical education.

name: Dr. Qadnana Atif Anwar
bio: Community member and family physician.

name: Uthala Abdullah
bio: Community member, registered nurse, and parent.

name: Zeinab Osman
bio: Zeinab Osman is a Community Engagement Specialist and Program Coordinator for Future Now in the College Community School District, where she helps students facing barriers take part in activities, academics, and volunteering, and prepare for life after high school. Fluent in English, Arabic, and Spanish, she works closely with English Language Learners and their families. She holds a bachelor's degree in International Relations and a master's in Conflict Analysis and Resolution, and is pursuing a second master's in Special Education.

name: Rashad Akinci
bio: Community member and entrepreneur in transportation and logistics.
